Rina: bringing up nova-mini-6b int4. seeing consistent comma/tokenization wobble compared to fp16 on short completions.

Diego: share repro?

Rina: `python run_eval.py --model nova-mini-6b --quant int4 --prompt \"The results, however, were\" --seed 7`
FP16 -> "The results, however, were promising."
INT4 -> "The results , however , were promising ."

Kai: hmm. likely vocab index hole or conversion added reserved ids. Did you run `scripts/vocab_check.py`?

Rina: ran it: reports a placeholder token at id 50000 named "<_>". conversion log shows `--insert-placeholder` used by accident.

Diego: that explains it. high-id placeholders can alias when we pack kv cache offsets and apply rotary. Try converting again with `--preserve-ids` and re-run `bin/compare_phase.py --fp16 fp16_run --int4 int4_run`.

bench-bot: quick perf: int4 latency 36ms/token, ppl delta +1.1 vs fp16 on short-bleu set.

Kai: also validate tokenizer normalizer; some converter flows change whitespace handling. run `python -c \"from tokenizers import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer.from_file(\'nova-mini-6b-tokenizer.json\').encode(\" , \"))\"`

Rina: re-running conversion now without placeholder. will post results. filing onboard ticket ONB-987.
